dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Wow, this place is so neat and tidy, it's basically perfect. There's nothing for me to do here at all...

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: In which case, let's play instead!

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: I'll get Yuegui to hide somewhere, and you try to find it. Hehe, I play this game with my friends a lot!
